note: Shared Environment + Reward Spine — RESEARCH REGISTRY. Repo2RLEnv-style repo->verifiable-RL-env synthesis, agent eval harnesses, reward protocols, and environment standards cataloged as CANDIDATE/REFERENCE only — NEVER active. GOVERNANCE: discovery != trust; candidate != active; benchmark result = EVIDENCE, never promotion authority; agent/LLM output is never truth; entries needing Docker/network/LLM/keys stay candidate until a local equivalent + sandbox/secret/receipt/no-bypass/license-provenance proofs exist AND the owner authorizes Docker/keys; source/provenance license is tracked. This registry triggers NO install, NO live run, NO Docker, NO API keys, NO dataset push. This spine MEASURES agents/runtimes (e.g. src/teleon/agents); it never promotes them.

status_codes.candidate: cataloged; wrapped behind a port; local equivalent first; runs only after proofs + owner authorization
status_codes.reference: external yardstick we compare against; not run in this repo
status_codes.active: FORBIDDEN here — promotion to active requires owner approval + the full proof_to_promote ladder

promotion_law: benchmark/environment result is EVIDENCE for a Teleon scorecard; it can never by itself promote a candidate. Humans approve boundary expansion.

entries.name: Repo2RLEnv (HuggingFace)
entries.purpose: turn a GitHub repo into verifiable RL tasks with an executable reward (test pass-rate / diff-oracle); exports to the Harbor task format
entries.provenance_note: original PR/commit/CVE contents remain under their source-repo licenses; datasets redistribute public commits for ML research — track per-source provenance
entries.local_equivalent: deterministic pr_diff-style fixture (text-only, NO Docker) behind a HarnessSynthProviderPort local stub
entries.teleon_fit: CapabilityTask candidate-vs-baseline EVIDENCE generator (repo->task->sandbox->reward mirrors capability->candidate->eval->scorecard)
entries.baltor_fit: pattern only — adapt as ContextPack2RLEnv; NOT a truth source (it measures code-agent capability, not governed truth)
entries.proof_to_promote: local stub + Shared Sandbox proof + secret-hygiene + EnvironmentRunReceipt + no-direct-provider-bypass + license/provenance + owner authorizes Docker/keys

entries.name: Harbor
entries.purpose: evaluate arbitrary agents (Claude Code/OpenHands/Codex) in sandboxed environments; the task format Repo2RLEnv + Terminal-Bench export to; runs environments in parallel via providers
entries.local_equivalent: OpenHarnessHub harness runner stub honoring the Harbor task shape, offline
entries.teleon_fit: candidate eval backend for PurposeTask candidates
entries.baltor_fit: indirect — runs the agents that improve Baltor/Teleon
entries.proof_to_promote: adopt Harbor task contract behind a port + local runner + sandbox proof + owner authorizes Docker/cloud providers

entries.name: OpenEnv (HuggingFace)
entries.purpose: Gymnasium-style interface (step/reset/state) for isolated execution environments for agentic RL post-training; more general than repo/SWE-specific generators
entries.local_equivalent: EnvironmentProviderPort step/reset/state shape with a local in-process environment
entries.teleon_fit: future runtime/eval adapter; strong standard SHAPE for the EnvironmentProviderPort

entries.name: Open Reward Standard (ORS)
entries.purpose: HTTP protocol connecting agents to RL environments — tool discovery, task access, reward delivery, episode progression; a standard agent<->environment boundary
entries.teleon_fit: candidate standard adapter for reward-bearing CapabilityTasks — the CTS should monitor this boundary
entries.proof_to_promote: RewardProviderPort conformance + offline reward proof + network policy

entries.name: RepoLaunch (Microsoft)
entries.purpose: turn a codebase into a testable sandbox — install deps, build, reconstruct Dockerfiles, organize test commands, parse test output into structured status; solves env setup (the hardest part of repo tasks)
entries.local_equivalent: deterministic local fixture repo with a known build/test command (no Docker)
entries.teleon_fit: candidate bootstrap provider for repo-based CapabilityTasks
entries.proof_to_promote: local bootstrap fixture + sandbox proof + owner authorizes Docker

entries.name: SWE-bench
entries.purpose: canonical benchmark of real GitHub issue repair — model generates a patch resolving the described problem; the external yardstick for SWE agents
entries.local_equivalent: n/a — reference yardstick, cite scores, do not run here
entries.teleon_fit: external yardstick if Teleon claims self-improving code/worker capability

entries.name: Terminal-Bench
entries.purpose: outcome-driven terminal tasks (instruction + Docker image + tests + time limit); uses the Harbor task format/harness; verifies final container state, not command traces — closer to Teleon's broad purpose-defined compute
entries.local_equivalent: local terminal-task fixture with a deterministic final-state check (no Docker)
entries.teleon_fit: general-purpose task executor benchmark candidate (beyond code editing)
entries.proof_to_promote: local fixture + Harbor-shape adapter + sandbox proof + owner authorizes Docker

entries.name: R2E-Gym
entries.purpose: procedurally curated executable gym (~8.1K tasks / 13 repos) with hybrid (execution + execution-free) verifiers via SWEGEN synthesis; SOTA open-weights SWE-agent results
entries.local_equivalent: small local sample of executable tasks (no Docker)
entries.teleon_fit: coding-agent training/eval candidate; connects to cheaper/local-model thesis
entries.proof_to_promote: local sample + verifier-pattern proof + owner authorizes Docker

entries.name: SWE-smith
entries.purpose: turn any GitHub repo into a SWE-gym; generates large synthetic task sets (50k instances / 128 repos) to train SWE-agent LMs; Docker for execution
entries.local_equivalent: tiny synthetic-task fixture (no Docker, no large dataset)
entries.proof_to_promote: local fixture + dataset-provenance + owner authorizes Docker/large-datasets

entries.name: SWE-Gym
entries.purpose: manually curated training environments (~2.4K real Python tasks / 11 repos) each with an executable env + unit tests (agent + verifier training)
entries.proof_to_promote: local sample + verifier proof + owner authorizes Docker

entries.name: NVIDIA NeMo Gym
entries.purpose: environments for training/evaluating models/agents — multi-step tool calling, multi-turn Gymnasium envs, session state; more relevant when GPU/model-training matures
entries.proof_to_promote: deferred until GPU/training is a priority + owner authorizes
